## Description

Writing a `SURFACE_OF_REVOLUTION` built on an `ELLIPSE` to STEP and reading back yields a `TRIMMED_CURVE` wrapping a degree-2 rational `B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` ellipse-equivalent instead of the original analytic `ELLIPSE`, plus drift in the revolved-axis `DIRECTION` away from unit norm (e.g. (0.99999999875, 0.00005, 0.0)). Analytic identity lost.

## Reproducer recipe

`SURFACE_OF_REVOLUTION` whose basis curve is an `ELLIPSE`; round-trip through STEP.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — preserve analytic basis curve (no Trimmed wrapper); reset orthonormal X/Y axes within 1e-6.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `heal`
